value.bench_notes: Investment-cast body. Shell relief, scrolls, pearl borders, recessed gallery and raised seat stock remain editable. Set the seven separate stones after casting; finish bearings and pavilion clearance to the actual stones. Retain satin recesses and polish raised ribs. Pull animation is a geometric study of an expendable pattern, not a sand-casting claim.
